request: Analyze GSE124676 for the paper (Exercise Reverses Dysregulation of T-Cell-Related Function in Blood Leukocytes of Patients With Parkinson's Disease, PMC6997272): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: Ion Proton total RNA-seq (globin-depleted) of blood leukocytes; Tophat2/bowtie2 to hg19; Cuffquant + Cuffnorm normalized FPKM (S2.3.p1, S2.4.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: Group 1 only: 21 PD patients (10 tai chi, 11 MET), each sampled before and 48-72 h after a 12-week exercise program = 42 RNA-seq samples (S3.1.p1, S3.3.p1). Group 2 (19 patients) is qPCR/immunoassay validation only, not in GEO.
final.primary_estimand: Within-patient change in leukocyte gene expression after 12 weeks of exercise (after vs before), tai chi and MET pooled (S3.3.p1: exercise type gave no transcriptomic difference, so groups combined)
planned_contrasts: time after vs before, paired by patient, both exercise types pooled (S2.4.p1, S3.3.p1; paper: 1,873 DEGs, 417 higher after, 1,453 higher before)
final.paper_method: paired Student t-test on Cuffnorm FPKM, before vs after (S2.4.p1); scale of the tested values (linear or log) not stated
final.paper_results: 1,873 DEGs (S3.3.p1; 1,453 + 417 = 1,870, internal mismatch of 3). Down after: ODC1 (most down), CD3E, GRAP2, FOS, ZAP70, IL2RA/B, TNFRSF18, RTP5, CCL5, CD28; up after: TRAF3, TNF, AGAP2 (S3.3.p2-p3, S3.4.p1-p3, S3.5.p2). KEGG: TCR signaling down, osteoclast differentiation up (S3.4.p1).

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Methods S2.4.p1 define a paired t-test before vs after exercise with raw P < 0.05 and no fold-change cutoff; S3.3.p1 pools tai chi and MET. No sedentary control arm exists: the estimand is a within-subject pre/post change in PD patients.

checks: metadata exercise counts at baseline 11 MET / 10 tai chi match S3.1.p1
data_processing matches S2.4.p1 (Cuffquant [-b,-u] + Cuffnorm FPKM, RefGene 2015 Feb, hg19)

ownership.reasoning: Accession, sample count, arm sizes and processing all match the paper.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns q1_*/q2_* equal metadata 'description' exactly (42/42, inspect alignment_keys). Subject = patient code in title (a19_before / a19f_after); 'f' suffix marks follow-up. time copied from characteristics time. extype kept as annotation only (subject a22 is labelled MET before but Tai chi after, a metadata inconsistency).

matrix.reasoning: File name, data_processing and paper all say normalized FPKM; values non-integer (integer fraction 0.40 driven by zeros), max 84,329 = linear scale. Not counts, so count methods are invalid.

design.subject: subject
design.reasoning: Paper's estimand is the paired pre/post change pooling both exercise modes (S3.3.p1). Exercise type is not a factor of the paper's DE analysis; tai chi vs MET is a between-subject comparison the paper reports as non-different and does not test for DEGs.

candidates.value: extype (MET vs Tai chi) as factor
candidates.reason_rejected: Not the paper's estimand; paper pooled the modes (S3.3.p1); a22 has conflicting labels across time points.

candidates.value: time within each exercise type separately
candidates.reason_rejected: Paper did not do it; would require resolving a22's conflicting label; ~10-11 pairs per arm.

covariates.name: extype
covariates.disposition: not_included: constant within subject (except a22 label error), absorbed by subject block; paper pooled modes

covariance.reasoning: Each patient contributes one before and one after sample; paper used a paired test to remove individual differences (S2.4.p1). Subject enters the model as a blocking factor.

final.method: limma (moderated t, ~ C(subject) + time) on log2(FPKM+1)

paper_route.method: paired Student t-test on Cuffnorm FPKM
paper_route.reason: No validated paired-t executor in the repository and the paper does not state whether FPKM was log-transformed; a hand-written t-test is not allowed. limma with a subject block is the validated paired equivalent (adds variance moderation).

deviations: limma moderated paired t (subject block) instead of ordinary paired t-test

method.reasoning: FPKM -> log2(x+1) -> limma is the policy route; subject as a block reproduces the pairing.

final.deviation_note: Paper's raw P < 0.05, no fold change, applied to the limma paired route; BH FDR < 0.05 reported as audit.

threshold.reasoning: S2.4.p1: 'Significantly differentially expressed genes (DEGs, P < 0.05)'; no multiple-testing correction or FC cutoff stated.

caveats: Pre/post design without a non-exercise control: changes include season, time and medication drift (paper S4.p7 notes climate).
Raw P < 0.05 threshold without multiple-testing correction, as in the paper.
Subject a22 exercise label differs between before (MET) and after (Tai chi) samples in GEO; irrelevant to the pooled contrast.

study.reasoning: Paper direction: ODC1, CD3E, GRAP2, FOS, ZAP70, IL2RA/B, TNFRSF18, RTP5, CCL5, CD28 down after; TRAF3, TNF, AGAP2 up after.

discrepancies.paper: ordinary paired t-test on FPKM (scale unstated)

executions.name: time_after_vs_before
executions.reasoning: Paired after vs before, subject block, log2(FPKM+1).

enrichment.reasoning: Paper ran KEGG/GO (DAVID) on up- and down-regulated DEGs separately (S3.4.p1, S3.4.p3).
Down-regulated ORA (paper: TCR signaling down) plus Hallmark GSEA on the full ranking.
